cases.finding: Same primitives under distinct contexts require context-indexed semantics.
Duplicate tie keys leave orientation selection ambiguous.
Multiple candidate outputs block deterministic MTO.
Equal observed outputs do not establish aspect equivalence.

boundary_updates: Context must be an explicit semantic input.
OTM must preserve multiplicity or prove set-losslessness.
Orientation tie keys must be unique and canonical.
MTO must be single-valued or expose an explicit unresolved result.
Output equality is insufficient for operand equivalence.
